blocks.text: Pollution ki qism aur shiddat (severity), jaise organic maddah, chemicals ya jaraseem (pathogens), ke hisaab se pani saaf karne ke mukhtalif tareeqe use hote hain. Yeh tareeqe safai ke teen darjon (levels) par use hote hain: primary treatment (bara kachra aur thos cheezein hatana), secondary treatment (biological, yani jaraseem ki madad se safai) aur tertiary treatment (chemicals se safai). Neeche ke qadmon (steps) mein physical, biological aur chemical tareeqe diye gaye hain jo pani se mukhtalif gandagi hatate hain.

Safai ka pehla qadam aam taur par screening aur sedimentation hai. Pani ko dhaat ki jaaliyon (metal screens) se guzaar kar bare na ghulne wale zarrat hata diye jate hain. Phir sedimentation hoti hai: pani ko bare tankon mein rok kar rakha jata hai taake us mein tairte thos zarrat (suspended solids) gravity (kashish-e-saql) se neeche tah mein baith jayein.

Bohat barik colloidal zarrat jaldi nahi baithte; unhein jaldi bithane ke liye coagulation aur flocculation ki jati hai. Yeh zaroorat ho to ki jati hai. Is mein pani mein ghuli gandagi (jaise heavy metals aur phosphates) ko na ghulne wali (insoluble) shakal mein badal kar neeche bitha diya jata hai (precipitation). Pani mein aluminium sulphate (Al₂(SO₄)₃) jaise chemical coagulants dale jate hain. Yeh chhote zarrat ko aapas mein jor kar bare guchhe bana dete hain jinhein “floc” kehte hain, aur yeh aasani se hat jate hain.

blocks.alt: Pani ke teen beaker. Oopar zard qatra (Coagulant Addition) aur lamba teer tick ke nishan tak. Before: safed impurities pani mein bikhri hui. Coagulant: chhote zard coagulant zarre impurities par chipke hue (Coagulant adsorbs onto impurities). Flocculant: safed aur zard zarron ke guchhe tah mein baithe hue (Flocs are formed and settled).
blocks.caption: Coagulation aur flocculation: before, coagulant, flocculant (kitab ki figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen beaker baen se daen parhein. Before: safed impurities pani mein bikhri hain. Coagulant: peele coagulant zarrat impurities se chipak jate hain (adsorb). Flocculant: sab zarrat jur kar floc bante hain aur tah mein baith jate hain; oopar ka pani saaf ho jata hai.

Jab zyada tar thos maddah hat jata hai to pani filter kiya jata hai. Yeh mechanical tareeqa hai jo baqi barik tairte zarrat aur kuch microorganisms hatata hai. Aam treatment plant mein pani darja-ba-darja (graded) ret aur bajri ki tahon se guzarta hai. Ret ek rukawat (barrier) ka kaam karti hai: zarrat ret ke daanon ke darmiyan ke chhote soorakhon (pores) mein phans jate hain. Zyada safai ke liye activated carbon use hota hai.

Sirf filtration se ghule hue ions ya bohat chhote jaraseem nahi hatte, is liye chemicals se safai zaroori hai. Chlorination jaraseem maarne ka sab se aam tareeqa hai. Doosre tareeqon mein sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl), ozone (O₃) ya kabhi hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) use hota hai. Jab chlorine gas ya sodium hypochlorite pani mein dali jati hai to hypochlorous acid (HOCl) banta hai; yeh bacteria aur viruses ki cell wall ke andar ghus kar un ke cell ka kaam bigar deta hai.
iv. Reverse Osmosis (RO) aur Ion Exchange
Bohat khalis pani (high-purity water) banane ke liye, jaise laboratory ke liye ya un ilaqon mein jahan pani bohat namkeen (high salinity) hai, reverse osmosis (RO) aur ion exchange use hote hain.

RO mein semi-permeable membrane (aisi jhilli jo sirf pani guzarne de) hoti hai; dabao (pressure) se pani membrane paar karta hai aur ghule namak, bacteria aur doosri napaki peeche reh jati hai. Ion exchange pani ko “naram” (soften) karne ki ahem technology hai. Sakht pani (hard water) mein Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ions zyada hote hain; yeh industry ke kaam aur sabun ke asar (soap efficiency) mein rukawat dalte hain. Ion-exchange column mein yeh ions Na⁺ ya H⁺ ions se badal diye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: reverse osmosis. Dabao (pressure) wala piston namkeen pani par; beech mein purple dashed semi-permeable membrane; neele pani ke zarre membrane paar kar ke saaf pani ki taraf jate, narangi namak ke zarre peeche reh jate. Daen: ion exchange column; oopar sakht pani (Ca2+, Mg2+) dakhil hota, oopar ke resin beads ne Ca2+ aur Mg2+ pakre hue hain, neeche ke beads par abhi Na+ hai, aur neeche se narm pani (Na+) nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Reverse osmosis aur ion exchange (hamara apna khaaka; kitab in ki koi figure nahi chhapti).
blocks.long_description: Ion exchange mein resin Na+ de kar Ca2+ aur Mg2+ le leta hai: 2RNa + Ca2+ se R2Ca + 2Na+ banta hai (R = resin).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: R ka matlab resin (column ke beads) hai. Resin apne Na⁺ ions pani mein chhor deta hai aur badle mein Ca²⁺ (aur isi tarah Mg²⁺) pakar leta hai. Is tarah pani se sakhti paida karne wale ions nikal jate hain. (Yeh equation kitab mein nahi; samjhane ke liye di gayi hai.)

blocks.alt: Baen se daen: Waste water Coagulation tank mein; neeche se Chemical addition ka teer tank ki taraf; pipe Flocculation tank tak jis mein do paddles hain aur oopar se Chemical Addition ka teer; phir Sedimentation tank jis mein dhalwaan tah aur neeche Sludge ka teer; phir Filtration tank jis mein jaali-dar filter bed; pump; aur Chlorination and Disinfection tank se Treated Water bahar.
blocks.caption: Figure 33.4: Pani saaf karne ke plant ka khaaka (kitab ki Figure 33.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 33.4 ko baen se daen parhein: ganda pani (waste water) → Coagulation (chemical dale jate hain) → Flocculation (paddles hila kar floc banate hain) → Sedimentation (floc neeche baith kar sludge banta hai) → Filtration → Chlorination aur Disinfection → saaf pani (treated water).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 33.4 mein Coagulation tank ke neeche wala “Chemical addition” ka teer tank se bahar (neeche ki taraf) chhapa hai, jaise kuch nikal raha ho. Asal mein coagulant (maslan Al₂(SO₄)₃) tank mein dala jata hai, is liye yahan teer tank ki taraf banaya gaya hai. Sirf Sludge ka teer bahar jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Pani ki safai mein aluminium sulphate ka kimiyai kirdar kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh coagulant hai: barik colloidal zarrat ko jor kar floc banata hai, jo baith kar hata diya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Aaloodah pani ko mehfooz banane ke liye sirf ubalna ya filtration kafi kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Ubalna zyada tar khurdbeeni jandaar maarta lekin heavy metals jaise ghule kimiyai maddey nahi hatata; filtration mu'allaq maddah hatati lekin ghule ions ya tamam jarasim nahi, is liye disinfection (aur zarurat ho to RO ya ion exchange) bhi use hota hai.

items: Safai ke darje: primary (thos kachra), secondary (biological), tertiary (chemical).
Qadam: screening aur sedimentation; coagulation aur flocculation (Al₂(SO₄)₃ se floc); filtration (ret, bajri, activated carbon); disinfection (Cl₂, NaOCl, O₃, H₂O₂; HOCl jaraseem maarta hai).
RO: dabao se membrane ke paar khalis pani; ion exchange: Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ki jagah Na⁺ ya H⁺.
